page.overview:
What is Team Go-Getters?

Team Go-Getters (チーム ガンバルズ Team Ganbarus) is a Rescue Team from the anime special "Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters out of the Gate!". It is comprised of Charmander, Chikorita, and Squirtle.

Charmander acted as the leader of the team. He was the one to find Squirtle knocked out, learn Flamethrower, and protect the team.

Chikorita was one of Charmander's partners. She protected Pichu from the Poison Powder attack.

Squirtle was the Pokémon on he team to claim he was a human. He was a little clumsy, and didn't know how to swim and was recruited as the team's newest member. Throughout the episode, he focused on learning Water Gun.
